source_title: NPK International Investigation Notice: Levi & Korsinsky Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into NPK International (NPKI)
source_excerpt:
NPK International lowered its full-year 2026 revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance, citing adverse Texas weather that delayed expected matting deployments on large-scale projects. Levi & Korsinsky is investigating potential securities law violations on behalf of NPKI investors.
NEW YORK , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NPK International (NYSE: NPKI ) shares fell after the Company's October 29, 2026 after-hours earnings release cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $300-$305 million from $313-$323 million. If you lost money on NPKI shares, you may have legal rights. Investors who suffered losses are encouraged to submit your NPKI loss information now . You may also contact Joseph E. Levi, Esq. via email at [email protected] or by telephone at (212) 363-7500.
Management attributed the shortfall to exceptionally dry Texas weather that delayed matting deployments and reduced rental activity. Despite previously acknowledging weather-related risks to operations, the Company did not lower its FY2026 outlook until October 29.

Full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance fell from $97â$103 million to $90â$93 million, representing an $8.5 million, or 8.5%, reduction in the midpoint. Levi & Korsinsky's investigation concerns potential securities law violations on behalf of investors who lost money on NPKI shares.
Shareholders who lost money on NPK International are encouraged to request a free review of their NPKI losses . Joseph E. Levi, Esq. can also be reached at [email protected] or (212) 363-7500.

Frequently Asked Questions About the NPKI Investigation
Q: Who is conducting the NPKI investigation? A: Levi & Korsinsky, LLP is investigating potential securities law violations on behalf of investors who purchased NPKI securities. The firm is nationally recognized, ranked in the ISS Top 50 for seven consecutive years, and has recovered hundreds of millions of dollars for aggrieved investors.
Q: Who is eligible to participate in the NPKI investigation? A: Investors who purchased NPKI stock or securities and suffered financial losses may be eligible. Eligibility is based on purchase date and documented losses -- not on whether you still hold the shares.
Q: Which statements are being investigated as potentially misleading? A: The investigation concerns whether NPK International made misleading statements or omissions regarding its full-year 2026 financial outlook, including the impact of weather conditions on matting demand and deployments for large-scale projects. When the Company reduced its 2026 guidance on October 29, 2026, the stock price declined.
Q: What do NPKI investors need to do right now? A: Investors may gather brokerage records showing purchase dates, share quantities, and prices paid. Submit your information for a no-cost, no-obligation evaluation of your potential recovery . No immediate action is required to remain eligible to participate in the investigation.
Q: What documents do I need to participate? A: Brokerage statements or trade confirmations showing purchase dates, share quantities, prices paid, and any subsequent sale dates and prices.
Q: What if I already sold my NPKI shares -- can I still recover losses? A: Yes. Eligibility is based on when you purchased, not whether you still hold the shares. Investors who bought NPKI and sold at a loss may still participate in the investigation.
Q: What does it cost me to participate? A: There is no upfront cost to submit your information and review whether you may be eligible to recover. Should you choose to participate in any resulting action, these matters are generally handled on a contingency basis, with any attorneys' fees and expenses subject to court approval.
Q: Do I need to go to court or give testimony? A: No. Participating in the investigation does not require court appearances or depositions. If legal action is later pursued, the overwhelming majority of affected investors never appear in court either.
